messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: PD#7521 - AZ6 serving degradation detected (eviction spike + request 5xx increase). Auto-escalation policy triggered.

maria: acked PD#7521. I'm on it, looking at metrics now. @sohail i'll hand off if this needs infra.

maria: quick summary — az6 has sustained high KV cache evictions on runtime-3 pools, causing up to ~12% 5xx for served requests in eu-west-az6. Latency p50 up ~40ms, p95 up ~200ms for longer contexts.

sohail: oncall standby. can you paste the alert details?

pd-bot: PD#7521 acknowledged by maria at 1739002475. Escalation to level-2 in 3m if not resolved.

maria: alert payload: region=eu-west, az=az6, cluster=runtime-3, metric=kv_evictions/sec, value=312. Runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/az-fallback

jamie: tagging known issue — we saw similar pattern last month after a kernel upgrade on runtime-3 nodes. Not sure if the maintenance window touched az6.

maria: checking node health and recent host reboots. 2/24 runtime-3 hosts showing OOM kills in dmesg. pulling logs:
```
[2026-03-15T02:07:12Z] oom_killer invoked pid=6821 /srv/serve
[2026-03-15T02:08:03Z] kv_cache_reclaim: evicted 1200 entries
```

sohail: if OOMs are happening we should activate routing fallback for az6 to divert new traffic to az4/az7. Triggering canary diversion now.

maria: doing canary divert (10% traffic) via router CLI:
```
router-bot: div set --region eu-west --from az6 --to az4,az7 --percent 10 --reason "kv_eviction_surge"
```

router-bot: Canary diversion set. 10% traffic diverted from az6 -> [az4, az7]. Monitoring error rates.

maria: seeing immediate drop in 5xx for diverted sessions. az6 still at ~9% 5xx for non-diverted. Increasing diversion to 40% to reduce customer impact.

sohail: agree. Also kick off a controlled node drain for the two hosts with OOM to cycle them and relieve memory pressure. I'll run the drain and let autoscaler create replacement nodes.

maria: drain commands queued (dry-run -> then execute):
```
infractl drain --host host-az6-203 --grace 60s
infractl drain --host host-az6-207 --grace 60s
```

pd-bot: PD#7521 escalated to infra@redwood at 1739002620 (sohail).

sohail: executing drain now. expecting replacement nodes in ~6m. I'll monitor k8s events.

maria: updating incident header: severity=sev2 (regional degradation), customer-impact: partial (some requests seeing 5xx, many requests mitigated by diversion). Notifying support for customer communications.

jamie: tagging customers affected: enterprise clusters pinned to az6 (small subset) — we should prepare an outage note if diversion increases.

maria: increasing diversion to 65% to protect overall traffic. router-bot confirm?

router-bot: diversion updated. 65% traffic now routed off az6 -> az4,az7 (split 40/25).

sohail: drain complete for host-203, host-207 rebooted and rejoined cluster. Observed reclaim and lower evictions. Replacement pods scheduled.

maria: good signs — kv_evictions/sec dropped from 312 -> 48 on post-drain samples. 5xx for az6 down to 3.2%.

pd-bot: PD#7521 note: mitigation in progress. Next escalation at 1739003220 if regression observed.

maria: I'll start rolling the runtime-3 kernel across remaining hosts in az6 as a precaution. will do a canary patch on host-210 first.

kevin: heads up — my shift starts in 20m. if this is still active, please hand off.

maria: copying current state for handoff to kevin:
- PD: #7521, sev2, region eu-west/az6
- Mitigation: router diversion 65% active; drained 2 hosts (host-203/207) successfully; kernel patch canary running on host-210.
- Impact: partial customer-facing 5xx reduced from 12% -> ~3% after remediations.
- Next steps: finish canary kernel rollout, monitor evictions, gradually reduce diversion back to baseline once stable, prepare customer comms if pinned clusters still affected.

kevin: acked. I'll take over at 1739003100. I'll keep escalation path ready and coordinate with support for comms.

maria: handing off — steps documented in incident ticket: https://redwood.incidents/incident/7521. Also created a postmortem stub.

sohail: closing loop — autoscaler replaced drained nodes, kernel canary looks clean so far. Recommend waiting 30m after rollout before removing diversion.

kevin: thanks — taking over monitoring. leaving PD#7521 in acknowledged state. will update and close when diversion returns to baseline and 5xx stable under 1%.

maria: nice work team. filing follow-up action items: infra to audit kernel releases in runtime-3 fleet, ops to refine auto-diversion thresholds. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident 7521 updated: assignees [maria, kevin, sohail], severity=sev2, status=mitigated. Postmortem draft: https://redwood.postmortems/7521-draft

kevin: (later) currently steady. will queue final closure after 60m of stability.
